rawContent: I approach this like celebrity breakups. When #metoo started I thought of the people who I would be crushed to find out are bad guys, allowing for no more than 5. So far the 2 people I would be crushed to find out are actually bad are not actually bad. So far.
@HeidiStevens13 I think I told you already I had a couple girlfriends who stated, with a tone if you ask me, that no one had ever harassed them when #metoo was first gearing up.
